model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the development over time of four distinct economic sectors, with the vertical axis representing their value in units ranging from 0 to 200,000 on a linear scale, and the horizontal axis representing time, though the specific time units or range are not labeled. The gray line, representing “Преработваща промишленост” (Processing Industry), starts near 30,000, fluctuates with minor peaks around 50,000 and 40,000, then sharply increases to nearly 200,000 by the end. The blue line, labeled “Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения” (Creation and dissemination of information and creative products; telecommunications), begins near 35,000, dips slightly, then rises steadily to approximately 170,000. The orange line, for “Селско, горско и рибно стопанство” (Agriculture, forestry, and fishing), remains nearly flat near zero throughout. The yellow line, corresponding to “Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети” (Trade; repair of automobiles and motorcycles), also stays very low, hovering near zero with a slight upward trend ending at around 10,000.
